nom: Buttah Skin Tea Tree Exfoliating Scrub

segments.dry: Reports from dry-skinned reviewers differ sharply: one with dry, hormonal acne-prone skin says the scrub burned and broke her out twice, while another with dry skin reports no more pimples and a fresher face since starting to use it.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are consistently positive, several calling it the first scrub that exfoliates gently without leaving their skin worse, some choosing to use it just once a week to keep it gentle.
segments.oily: One reviewer with naturally oily skin, plus dry patches around her mouth from mask-wearing, found it the right fit for both concerns at once.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports it works well for her, smelling great and leaving her skin smooth.

concerns.blemishes: The majority of reviewers credit the scrub with clearer skin and fewer breakouts, several describing pimples shrinking or disappearing overnight and hormonal chin acne improving with twice-weekly use; the exception is a reviewer with dry, acne-prone skin who says it burned her and caused two separate breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily areas report the scrub leaves skin feeling clean and moisturized without added shine, with one specifically noting her T-zone became less oily over the summer months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Despite being a physical exfoliant, most reviewers say it doesn't strip or dry out the skin, several specifically noting skin feels hydrated, soft, and not tight afterward; one reviewer with dry, dull skin says it reversed that dryness with regular use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with dry, acne-prone skin reported a burning sensation both times she used the scrub; most other reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no burning or irritation despite the product's strong tea tree scent and tingling sensation.
concerns.spots: One reviewer specifically notes that dark spots on her chin have been clearing up with continued use.

aspects.libelle: Tube or bottle packaging can crack or split
Strong tea tree scent, not for everyone
Pleasant tingling, cooling sensation on skin
Can feel hard to rinse off for some
Concentrated, a little goes a long way
Doubles as cleanser, mask, and exfoliant

extraits.titre: Wanted to like this but it broke me out twice.
extraits.texte: Really wanted to like this product as I have the moisturizer from this company, but it broke me out twice. The first time I tried it, felt a slight burning sensation but thought it was the tea trea oil working. I had some steak the day before so when I broke out the next day, I figured it was the steak. Decided to give it another go just to make sure and it burned me and broke me out. I have acne hormonal dry skin so just advised for others like me.

extraits.titre: Leaves my face feeling slick and slippery
extraits.texte: I like the smell and consistency of the product, but it's hard for me to wash off. I don't enjoy face products that leave my face feeling slippery, which is the case here, but overall, a good product.

My skin has never felt so smooth after one use of this product. I have naturally have oily skin, but I have dry patches around my mouth and chin area due to wearing a mask. So I believe I've found the perfect product for those concerns. I recommend this product for the melanin ladies, but please do research on what's best for YOUR skin's needs.

I love this product. I use this as face cleaner in the morning even though this is a face mask. I apply small amount of this product on my dry skin, let it dry amount a couple of minutes and then wet and massage my face and rinse it off. My face is so fresh and clean! No more pimples since I start using this.
I have combination skin. This works really well for me, smells great, leaves my skin smooth. A favorite product of mine.

I have a really sensitive skin and I've been unable to find a scrub that would gently exfoliate without leaving my skin worse than before. This scrub by Buttah is my holy grail. It's amazing. Just everything about it: the smell, how fresh my skin feels, the deeper clean I get without irritating my face is amazing.
The scrub left my skin feeling soft and smooth after applying. The smell has a nice fragrance to it. The dark spots on my chin is clearing. This is a great product!
